description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and structures related to message storage and metadata within the Thunder core messaging system. It includes definitions for events, message metadata, control interfaces, and various specialized message info classes for logging, tracing, warnings, assertions, and operational streams.

classes.name: IEvent
classes.description: Interface for event objects that can be serialized and deserialized, and provide data access.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Class representing message metadata, including type, category, and module information, with serialization support.

classes.name: IControl
classes.description: Interface for control objects with enable, destroy, and metadata methods, and static management functions.

classes.name: IControl::IHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling control events, with a handle method.

classes.name: MessageInfo
classes.description: Class extending Metadata to include timestamp information, with serialization and string conversion.

classes.name: IStore
classes.description: Interface for message storage, supporting default checks and push operations, with nested classes for different message types.

classes.name: IStore::Logging
classes.description: Data carrier for logging message info.

classes.name: IStore::Tracing
classes.description: Data carrier for tracing message info, including filename, line number, and class name.

classes.name: IStore::WarningReporting
classes.description: Data carrier for warning reporting message info, including callsign.

classes.name: IStore::OperationalStream
classes.description: Data carrier for operational stream message info.

classes.name: IStore::Assert
classes.description: Data carrier for assertion message info, including process ID, name, file, line, and callstack.

methods.name: Metadata::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Metadata object into a buffer.

methods.name: Metadata::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into the Metadata object.

methods.name: MessageInfo::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the MessageInfo object into a buffer.

methods.name: MessageInfo::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into the MessageInfo object.

methods.name: MessageInfo::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MessageInfo object.

methods.name: Tracing::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes tracing info into a buffer.

methods.name: Tracing::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes tracing info from a buffer.

methods.name: Tracing::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of tracing info.

methods.name: WarningReporting::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes warning reporting info into a buffer.

methods.name: WarningReporting::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes warning reporting info from a buffer.

methods.name: WarningReporting::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of warning reporting info.

methods.name: Assert::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes assert info into a buffer.

methods.name: Assert::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes assert info from a buffer.

methods.name: Assert::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of assert info.
